messages:
marta: Heads up — apiserver 5xx spike in eu-west-2 during a GPU pool scale-out (~12:15 UTC). Dashboard shows 5xx rate peaked ~15% for ~6m. Several pods stuck Pending. Anyone oncall?

raj: I'm oncall. Seeing apiserver request latency jump and controller-manager reconcile queue backing up. Could be etcd leader churn — starting to pull logs.

provisioner-bot: INFO: GPU autoscaler triggered in eu-west-2: scale-up +48 GPUs (request_id=as-2026-04-15-121142).

raj: quick etcd status snapshot:
```
etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.0.1.2:2379 endpoint status
# output:
# 10.0.1.2: leader=true, term=1432, raftIndex=982342
# 10.0.1.3: leader=false, term=1428, raftIndex=981990
# leader flips seen at 12:12:xx -> 12:13:xx multiple times
```

sam: controller-manager logs show repeated failures to renew leader lease and a bunch of `failed to update endpoints` errors. Snippet: `E0415 12:13:20.123 controller.go:455] lease renew failed: context deadline exceeded`

olivia: FYI I rolled out an egress rate-limit policy for eu-west-2 NATs earlier today to curb unexpected cloud egress costs (11:55 UTC). Could the throttling be blocking control plane <-> etcd follower replication?

marta: Possibly. If control-plane nodes can't talk to other zones, etcd RPCs will time out and leader election can thrash. Can someone check VPC flow logs and NAT gateway metrics?

raj: VPC flow shows increased SNAT errors and dropped connections around 12:11–12:17. NAT gateway CloudWatch shows `PacketDrop` spike. I'm reverting the NAT throttle now.

sam: Temporary mitigation: scaling back the GPU autoscaler to prevent another concurrent scale storm. Patch I'm applying:
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap gpu-autoscaler --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_concurrent_scaleups":"1"}}'
```

olivia: rollback of NAT throttle done. Monitoring egress; dropped packets falling back to baseline. Also opening a ticket with finops — this cost-control knob needs a safer rollout window.

marta: Actions: 1) olivia confirm NAT throttle rollback (done) 2) raj + sam plan controlplane node reboot cadence and validate etcd quorum 3) add autoscaler guardrail to limit concurrent scaleups (sam applied a temp patch) 4) postmortem if we confirm root cause.

raj: I'm going to cordon+drain one controlplane replica in AZ-b and cycle it, watching etcd metrics.

sam: I'll follow controller-manager and apiserver logs during the drain. Opening incident ticket: INFRA-2026-118 and adding runbook link.

olivia: noted — will coordinate with finops to avoid surprise cost bursts if we add pre-warm steps. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks all. Will update thread with timeline and decisions. :eyes:
